Here is the original recipe that I modified.

1 cup whole wheat flour
½ cup unbleached all-purpose flour
1 cup rolled oats
¾ cup ground flax seed (this is 1 T per muffin if you divide into 12 = 2g or fiber per muffin) 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda
½ teaspoon salt

1 egg
1 cup milk
½ cup honey (or ¼ C honey + ¼ C brown sugar) 1/3 cup vegetable oil
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup mashed bananas

  1. Combine all dry ingredients. Set aside.
  2. In mixing bowl beat eggs. Add milk and honey. Mix till honey is evenly blended. Mix (on low) in oil, vanilla, mashed bananas. Slowly add dry ingredients. Mix only until blended.
  3. Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper bake cups, and divide the batter among them.
  4. Bake at 400 degrees F (205 degrees C) for 18 minutes (or until a toothpick comes out clean).

Note: What I did not know/realize before I made these is that flax seed (according to the pkg I have) can be used in place of vegetable oil. Next time I am going to try eliminating at least part of the oil and replace it with the flax seed as the oil is about 960 calories. Apple sauce can also be used in place of the oil to eliminate some calorie density and increase nutrients (and sweetness).

Calorie info= 3,195C = 266.25 per muffin which is high. I definitely am going to eliminate the oil next time as it’s almost 1/3 of the total calories.
